Rules summary For tips on how to play marram, see Tips_marram Contents 1 How to play 1.1 Marram Classic 1.1.1 Place a tile 1.1.2 Flip a tile 1.2 Marram Pitchfork 2 Scoring 2.1 Marram Classic 2.2 Marram Pitchfork How to play Marram Classic Each turn, a player must do the following twice : place a tile; or flip a tile. Place a tile When placing a tile, all the features of adjacent tiles must match: grass tufts, sand, orange snakes, blue snakes and worms. If there are any remaining in their supply, a player may optionally place a welly boot on a feature of the placed tile. If the tile placement completes a feature, that feature scores for the player with the most welly boots on it. All welly boots from completed features are returned to their respective players. Flip a tile A player may only flip a tile if they have at least one remaining shovel in their supply. Flipping a tile expends a shovel from the player's supply. The player selects a tile with a shovel symbol on it and turns it over in place. If there are any welly boots on the flipped tile itself, they are removed from the game. The tile is then realigned, if necessary, so that its features match with the adjacent tiles. If more than one rotation is possible, the player may choose. The player may then optionally place a welly boot on a feature on the tile. Any features completed as a result of the flipping are scored, including those from welly boots just placed. Welly boots from completed features are returned to their owners. Marram Pitchfork Same as classic, except with using pitchforks for claiming the creatures. A completed creature will disappear from the board, making it much easier to complete grass tufts and sand mounds. Pitchforks will be returned to their owners for each completed creature. Scoring Marram Classic Completed features Type of feature Conditions Scoring Orange snake Must have two ends . 1 point for each end, plus 1 point for each middle segment. Worm Must have two ends and one saddle . 2 points for each end, 2 points for the saddle, plus 2 point for each middle segment. Blue snake Must have one head , one tail and at least one middle segment . 3 points for the head, 3 points for the tail, plus 3 points for each middle segment. Freak beasts Any worm or snake that fails to meet its species criteria 3 points. Grass tufts (Must be completely surrounded by sand) 5 points per bulge, plus 5 points for each gold coin and 3 points for each silver coin. Sand mounds (Must be completely surrounded by grass) 5 points per bulge, plus 4 points for each flower. Worm Must have two ends and one saddle . 2 points for each end, 2 points for the saddle, plus 2 point for each middle segment. Blue snake Must have one head , one tail and at least one middle segment . 3 points for the head, 3 points for the tail, plus 3 points for each middle segment. Freak beasts Any worm or snake that fails to meet its species criteria 3 points. Grass tufts (Must be completely surrounded by sand) 3 points per bulge, plus 4 points for each gold coin and 2 points for each silver coin. Sand mounds (Must be completely surrounded by grass) 3 points per bulge, plus 3 points for each flower.

[Rating: 1/10] One of the ugliest game I have ever seen, it's simply a bad rip-off of Carcassonne.

[Rating: 2/10] + Carcassonne-esque blocking opportunities and teasing opponent by creating freaks -- awful and distracting colour mix -- ugly to the eye -- gameplay feels frustrating more often than not

[Rating: 2/10] I really didn't enjoy this game. It just feels far too long for me and I had far too many turns where I didn't feel like I had any decent moves. The goals and turn structure of the game were fine, but I really disliked the game arc.

[Rating: 3/10] I don't see what the point of this game is.  It's basically just a bad version of Carcassonne.  At least Carcassonne has a ton of expansions that you can mix and match.

[Rating: 3/10] Digital.  Carcassonne knockoff and long and tough to complete things.  I have never heard a fellow Brit or anyone but the "designer" call it "Welly Boot"?  Wellington Boot! Painful and for 15 min short game, has taken 90 minutes
